mcqs.question: Until when was the Jal Jeevan Mission extended by the Union Cabinet?
mcqs.explanation: The Union Cabinet extended the Jal Jeevan Mission until December 2028. December 2024 refers to the end of Phase I, not the extended period of the mission.

mcqs.question: What was the total amount released under the 22nd instalment of PM-KISAN on 13 March 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The 22nd PM-KISAN instalment involved a total release of ₹18,640 crore to approximately 9.32 crore farmers. ₹2,000 was the amount received by each farmer, while ₹4.27 lakh crore is the cumulative amount disbursed so far.
